excluded_recorded_quantities.design_values.* (the eleven v1 raw desig: deliberately excluded: v1 showed the step discontinuities of the design -> geometry map dominate; v2 tests realised geometry instead
excluded_recorded_quantities.field.sweep_qois.axis_cusp_positions_m (: count equals stage_count for every design (verified); positions enter through the per-cell cusp distances
excluded_recorded_quantities.field.sweep_qois.axis_null_positions_m (: count equals stage_count + 1 for every design (verified); positions enter through the per-cell null distances
excluded_recorded_quantities.field.sweep_qois.field_peak_t: near-duplicate of bore_max_b_t (grid peak vs bore-grid peak); one peak descriptor is kept
excluded_recorded_quantities.geometry.chamber_length_m: equals stage_count * stage_pitch_m exactly for every design (verified); kept only as the extrapolation-cluster rule
excluded_recorded_quantities.geometry.dielectric_thickness_m: not a channel-interior quantity; wall_radius_m carries the interior geometry

provenance.bore_max_b_t: field.bore_max_b_t (maximum |B| on the screening's bore grid)
provenance.cell1_cusp_distance_pitches: launch_design.cell_to_field[gs1-cell-1].nearest_axis_bz_peak_distance_m / geometry.stage_pitch_m (axial distance from the cell centre to the nearest axis |Bz| peak, in pitches)
provenance.cell1_null_distance_pitches: launch_design.cell_to_field[gs1-cell-1].nearest_axis_null_distance_m / geometry.stage_pitch_m (distance to the nearest axis Bz null / cusp plane, in pitches)
provenance.exit_length_fraction_realised: geometry.exit_length_m / geometry.chamber_length_m (realised, after the sweep's minimum-length rule; NOT the design selector)
provenance.exit_length_m: geometry.exit_length_m (realised divergent exit-section length; 0 when the sweep suppressed the exit)
provenance.exit_outer_radius_ratio: geometry.exit_outer_radius_m / geometry.wall_radius_m (1 when there is no divergent exit)
provenance.exit_start_m: geometry.exit_start_m (axial start of the exit section)
provenance.first_polarity: geometry.first_polarity (+1 / -1 realised polarity of the first stage)
provenance.log10_minimum_mirror_ratio: log10(field.sweep_qois.minimum_mirror_ratio) (L1a sweep QoI; log because the ratios span two decades)
provenance.straight_length_m: geometry.exit_start_m - geometry.injector_length_m (channel straight length L from the injector face to the exit-section start)
provenance.wall_radius_m: geometry.wall_radius_m (r_w of the straight dielectric channel)

statement: every feature is a deterministic arithmetic function of the committed screening dataset row (geometry, field.sweep_qois, launch_design.cell_to_field); no feature is fitted, tuned, scaled by data statistics, or learned; the extraction code (features.py) is bound by hash in the code contract
